# Zebra

> A Bun-first TypeScript web framework with first-class dependency injection. Built on `Bun.serve` and Web Standard `Request`/`Response` — no Node compat layer. Every app is built around a DI `Container` whose graph is validated at boot.

Zebra v2 (current) is a rewrite. v1 (2019) is archived on the `v1-archive` git tag. The framework is at v1.0: the public API surface is frozen (`docs/api-freeze.md` defines the stability promise and SemVer policy) across the facade `zebra` and the packages `@zebra/core` (DI, radix router, middleware, lifecycle, static files, WebSocket), `@zebra/contract`, `@zebra/client`, `@zebra/testing`, `@zebra/session`, `@zebra/cors`, and `@zebra/rate-limit`. All packages are versioned in lockstep at 1.0.0.

Core principles:
- DI is mandatory, not bolted on. Routes and middleware declare their dependencies via a named-object spec (`{ svc: Service }`); the container resolves them and validates the full graph (circular deps, scope violations) at boot. The `Zebra` instance exposes `injectSingleton` / `injectRequest` / `injectTransient` / `injectSession` (class bindings), `injectFactorySingleton`/`injectFactoryRequest`/… (factory bindings, with optional declared-deps form for boot validation), and `injectValue` (value bindings) — so most apps never construct a `Container` directly.
- Web Standards. Handlers receive a `ZebraRequest` (a `Request` superset with `params`, `query`, and lazy body parsing) and return a `Response` or value.
- Structured errors. Default error responses follow RFC 9457 (Problem+Json) via `HttpError`.
- Contract-first (oRPC style). Contracts are frozen pure-data defs built with the chained, immutable `zc` builder (`zc.get(path).params(s).query(s).body(s).output(s).status(n).errors(e).meta(m)`); schemas use Standard Schema V1 (`~standard`, works with Zod/Valibot/ArkType). `app.implement(proc | router, deps?, impls, opts?)` constrains and runtime-validates handlers (params/query/body → 422 with prefixed issues; output re-validated and stripped; raw Response passthrough; 204 → empty body). `@zebra/client` `createClient(router, { baseUrl, fetch?, headers? })` derives a type-safe client (types only; non-2xx throws `ClientError {status, code, problem, response}`; zero runtime deps, browser-safe). Contract, core, and client each vendor the protocol + Standard Schema interfaces (parity guarded by type tests). `app.routeTable` and `RegisteredRoute.contract` are the OpenAPI/introspection seam.
- Four DI scopes: singleton, request, session, transient — with scope-rank rules enforced at boot.

## Packages

- [`zebra`](packages/zebra): public facade — re-exports `@zebra/core`, `@zebra/cors`, `@zebra/session`, and (aliased) `@zebra/rate-limit`
- [`@zebra/core`](packages/core): app, DI container, radix router, HTTP layer, middleware, lifecycle, contract implement + routeTable, WebSocket
- [`@zebra/contract`](packages/contract): contract builder (`zc`), `prefix`, protocol (Standard Schema V1; zero deps)
- [`@zebra/client`](packages/client): `createClient` derived typed client (zero deps)
- [`@zebra/testing`](packages/testing): `createTestApp` + `createTestClient` in-process (no sockets)
- [`@zebra/session`](packages/session): cookie sessions — HMAC-signed `sid`, pluggable `SessionStore`, fixation-safe
- [`@zebra/cors`](packages/cors): CORS middleware — preflight, origin allowlists, credentials echo
- [`@zebra/rate-limit`](packages/rate-limit): fixed-window rate limiting — 429 Problem+Json, `X-RateLimit-*` headers, pluggable store

## Public API surface

The complete frozen export list for every package is in [`docs/api-freeze.md`](docs/api-freeze.md) — the authoritative v1 surface (stability promise + SemVer policy + per-package export lists). Summary of the core package surface (`packages/core/src/index.ts`):

- App: `Zebra`, `ZebraOptions`, `RouteHandler`, `DepsSpec`, `ResolvedDeps`, `RegisteredRoute`, `GroupApi`, `LifecycleEvent`, `LifecycleHandler`, `PathParams`, `JoinPath`, `SessionOptions`, `validateGraph`, `VERSION`
- Contract (core): `implement` (on `Zebra`), `routeTable` (on `Zebra`), `ContractHandler`, `ContractProcedure`, `RouterImpl`, `ImplementOptions`, `isContractProcedure`
- Contract (shared): `zc` chain (`@zebra/contract`), `prefix`, `StandardSchemaV1`, `InferParams/Query/Body/Output`
- Client: `createClient`, `ClientError`, `ContractClient`, `ClientOptions` (`@zebra/client`)
- DI: `Container`, `token`, `Token`, `injectable`, `inject`, `ScopeKind`, `Disposable`, `CircularDependencyError`, `UnboundTokenError`, `ScopeMismatchError`
- HTTP: `ZebraRequest`, `buildRequest`, `HttpError`, `ValidationError`, `toProblemJson`, `ProblemJson`
- Middleware: `Middleware`, `middleware`, `getMiddlewareDeps`
- WebSocket: `WsHandler`, `WsData`, `WsRoute`

## Source layout (`packages/core/src/`)

- `app/` — `app.ts` (Zebra class), `boot-validation.ts`, `group.ts`, `lifecycle.ts`, `types.ts`
- `di/` — `container.ts`, `binding.ts`, `decorators.ts`, `disposable.ts`, `errors.ts`, `key.ts`, `scope.ts`, `token.ts`
- `http/` — `request.ts`, `body.ts`, `errors.ts`, `static.ts`
- `middleware/` — `compose.ts` (Koa-style), `error.ts` (Problem+Json), `helper.ts`, `types.ts`
- `router/` — `radix.ts` (radix-tree router), `path.ts`

## Examples

- [`examples/hello`](examples/hello): minimal Zebra app
- [`examples/blog`](examples/blog): DI services, route groups, structured errors
- [`examples/contract-blog`](examples/contract-blog): contract-first end-to-end (`start` server, `client` typed round-trip)

Run from repo root: `bun --filter example-hello start`, `bun --filter example-blog start`, or `bun --filter example-contract-blog start` / `client`.

## Tooling

- Runtime: Bun (required — uses `Bun.serve`, `Bun.file`)
- TypeScript: `experimentalDecorators` and `emitDecoratorMetadata` required; `reflect-metadata` imported once at entry
- Lint/format: Biome (`bun run lint`, `bun run format`)
- Test: `bun test`
- Build all: `bun run build`
- Typecheck all: `bun run typecheck`
